headline: Sen. Lindsay Graham and a group of senators announced an agreement with the Trump administration on legislation to hold buyers of Russian oil and gas accountable. The deal comes as Reuters reported today that Russia's gasoline output now covers only 65% of consumer demand, a shortfall driven by recent Ukrainian strikes on shipping, refineries and other petroleum infrastructure. Further reports indicate Russia has closed the Don-Azov channel to shipping after Ukrainian forces struck close to 50 ships across the Sea of Azov and Black Sea over the past 4-5 days.
